Background[]

Development[]

Once again, this season was revealed by production ahead of an official renewal announcement from CBS, when they updated their casting website on August 1, 2025 during Big Brother 27 (US).

On May 13, 2026, it was announced that the season would have a 90-minute premiere on Thursday, July 9, 2026, followed by another 90-minute episode the next Sunday. The traditional Sunday, Wednesday, Thursday episode schedule returned, with all episodes airing at 8 PM throughout the season. The 90-minute Wednesday episodes returned for this season, while the Sunday and Thursday episodes would remain at an hour length following the premiere week. This season marked the 1000th episode of Big Brother US, a primetime television first, and featured the most programming hours in the show's history. It was also announced that the companion show, Big Brother: Unlocked, would return for its second season, airing every other Friday at 8 PM starting on July 10.[1]

Canadian Viewership Changes[]

On May 26, 2026, it was announced that this season would be the last one to air on Global in Canada. Global was the home of Big Brother US in Canada since its debut, and aired Canada's own Big Brother franchise from 2014 to 2024, after picking it up from sister channel Slice.[2] On June 4, 2026, it was later announced that future seasons would air on CTV, following Bell Media's acquisition of Big Brother Canada.[3]

Possible Chinese Leak[]

Note: The "Big Brother Wiki" has archived the Leaked Advertising Pitch via the Official X Account, you can see it here

On June 24, 2026, a leak to a Paramount Advertising in China was leaked via a WeChat link on X.[4] In the pitch to Chinese advertisers, Paramount listed a promotional pitch for aspects on potential sponsorships for the Chinese social media platform Douban.

In the leak, the following pitched possible aspects of the season were revealed:

  • The Potential Finale Date of October 1, 2026
  • The Season's Theme of "Time Trip"
  • Twists Including:
    • Returning Players
    • "BB Time Capsule" Competition, where "fans will vote to select a guest to participate in a high-stakes challenge to win legendary privileges or face classic punishments from BB history."
    • 1,000 Episode Special
    • Derek Xiao replacing Derrick Levasseur as the co-host of Big Brother: Unlocked

Unlocked Changes[]

On June 30, 2026, CBS announced that actor Jerry O'Connell would join the second season of Big Brother: Unlocked alongside returning hosts and former winners Derrick Levasseur and Taylor Hale from the first season.[5] O'Connell returns to the franchise after appearing on the second episode of Unlocked in season 1.[6] Prior to that, O'Connell was brought in last minute to guest host the Week 8 Eviction in Big Brother 26 (US) after it was announced that Julie Chen-Moonves was quarantining from a COVID infection.[7]

In the official release, O'Connell stated, "Big Brother is my summer and rolls into my fall too. I’m already watching on Wednesdays, Thursdays and Sundays, so the fact that CBS is now paying me to do it is kind of amazing. It’s an absolute honor to sit next to Derrick – ‘Champ,’ as I call him – and Taylor, who is my all-time favorite Big Brother winner (sorry, Jag). This is what we call in showbiz a dream gig. I’ll do my best to be the voice of the fans, but as Julie says, expect the unexpected. And most importantly, remember to love one another. I’m soooo excited to join the Big Brother fam!"

The first episode of the sideshow would go on to premiere on July 10th, the night after the premiere.

Unlike the previous season, Unlocked now featured a live audience for tapings and included voting aspects that would change the game.

House Reveal[]

On July 1st, 2026, CBS released the official house for the first time as the "Time Trip" theme, in which was leaked earlier via the Chinese Promotional Leak earlier in the preseason.[8][4]

The theme has centered around time travel as the franchise prepares for it's landmarked 1,000 episode that will air during the season. The house has, "turning time into the ultimate twist. Houseguests will enter a world where rooms, relics and competitions transport them across moments in time, while early twists shake up the game from the start. Inspired by decades like the ’80s and Y2K, new powers and challenges can disrupt strategy and alliances."[9]

The original house released photos, taken by CBS photographer Matthew Taplinger:

According to the official press release, the house highlights include:

  • Time-Bending Entryway: Houseguests are greeted by a striking faux neon sign and a dizzying array of clocks, immediately setting the tone: time is fractured, unpredictable and constantly in motion.
  • Living Room of Eras: 17-foot gothic windows glow against oxblood stone walls, blending classic and industrial design alongside relics from across history, from a triceratops skull to royal crown jewels – a reminder that anything from any era could shape the game.
  • Nostalgic Trophies: A 1940s jukebox and an ’80s transparent phone highlight a surreal mix of decades, celebrating nostalgia as past, present and future collide inside the BB house.
  • Relic Lab Hallway: The iconic time laser returns alongside quirky failed inventions including a pogo stick, keytar and more, all displayed as relics of past experiments.
  • Clockwork Bathroom: Gears and intricate mechanical details surround Houseguests, while sub-atomic-inspired lighting fixtures create a visually stunning otherworldly atmosphere.
  • The Artifact Bedroom: Housing five houseguests, this artifact-filled room features two mysterious doorways – one to the past, one to the future.
  • Futuristic Sleep Pods Room: A sleek retreat with pod beds, organic ladders and nebula visuals offers a calm, futuristic escape from the chaos of the game.
  • Upstairs Lounge: Vintage tech lines the shelves. Massive arched windows overlooking the living room make it a prime vantage point for eavesdropping, while the custom-built sofa is perfectly suited for both strategizing and showmancing.
  • Time-Lapse Gym: Walls wrapped in time-lapse photography create the illusion of motion and progression, energizing Houseguests as they work out and reset.
  • Clock Tower Feature: Tying the entire house together, a dramatic clock tower crowns the space, a symbolic reminder that in this game, time is always ticking … but never predictable.[9]

Earlier in the week, Julie Chen-Moonves led journalists on a tour inside of the house.

Potential Returning Aspects[]

As the season is a theme of a blast to the past, Julie hinted as some previous season aspects could be returning to the Big Brother game.

In a quote to Men's Journal reporter Sharon Tharp, she stated, "time travel, so that could go forward or backwards, and that will play into some of the competitions. Maybe we’ll do the new twist, which is you love that competition in Season 4, but they have to be in, like, I don’t know, surrounded by dinosaurs, who knows."[10]

Julie would then state that "Controversial people will be factored in." When asked who, and the possibility of which other possible reality show could be featured, she stated, "If you’re a Big Brother fan, you’ll be like, ‘Aha!’ And I think a lot of people will be like, ‘Yes!’ And I think some people [will be] like, ‘What?’ But it’s good TV. And if you love reality television beyond Big Brother…you’ll be excited as well."

Big Brother Broveal[]

On July 6, 2026, CBS announced the Big Brother: Broveal, a YouTube livestream that will be hosted by Julie as she reveals the cast and dives deeper into the theme, the house and the twists. Following this inaugural stream, the YouTube channel will be used to showcase Live Feeds for free for limited periods following the conclusion of each episode, including Unlocked. Live Feeds will still be hosted with full access for Pluto TV and Paramount+ subscribers.[11]

The reveal was set as a live premiere on YouTube on July 6th to air on July 7th.[12] However, an hour before it was to go live, it was taken offline in order to, according to Hamsterwatch, swap out a houseguest.[13][14]

In a post by Hamsterwatch, the letters "A A B C D D H J K L L L M M R R T" were revealed to be the initials of the seventeen houseguests that would be entering the house.[14] When the cast was revealed, 13 initials would go on to match the 14 houseguests revealed by CBS.[15] It was then discovered that Levi Banks was supposed to be the fourteenth houseguest, but was replaced in the final moments by Yash Patel after it was revealed in a preseason article that was not adjusted before the reveal.[16][17]

That would be the explanation for the additional "L" and no "Y".

Shortly after the reveal, the official Paramount press site released a press release stating that, "Additional surprise Houseguests will be revealed on air," signifying that more houseguests would be revealed on the premiere episode.[15]

Additional Players Revealed[]

Three hours after the initial cast release, Entertainment Weekly's Dalton Ross revealed that Survivor contestants would be included in the season's cast. In an exclusive announcement for Entertainment Weekly, former Survivor: Edge of Extinction and Survivor 50: In the Hands of the Fans contestant Rick Devens would be joining the cast.[18]

In the same article, it stated "And Devens is not the only former Survivor competitor that will be part of the new cast, as EW has learned that a second former castaway will also be vying for Big Brother’s $750,000 prize. The identity of that second player has yet to be revealed."

As well as the Rick Devens speculation, former Survivor 45 winner and fellow Survivor 50: In the Hands of the Fans competitor Dee Valladares was leaked online by various social media accounts.[19][20] However, it would be revealed that Dee's participation would not be revealed until the first episode of Big Brother: Unlocked.[21]

One hour later, Sharon Tharp exclusively revealed that Angela Murray from Big Brother 26 (US) would be the sole Big Brother returnee.[21] By returning, season 28 becomes the second season in a row that a single Big Brother alum would return to play alongside new houseguests.

Time Travel Theme[]

The theme for the season was revealed to be time travel. Throughout the season, the houseguests would be traveling through time to compete in competitions and twists.

On premiere night, it was revealed that Enzo Palumbo from Big Brother 12 (US) & Big Brother 22 (US) was behind the dining room "time machine" with his "company" "Meow Meow Enterprises"

According to Enzo, the multi-verse laser from Big Brother 25 (US) & Big Brother: Reindeer Games that was broken by former houseguests Britney Haynes, Danielle Reyes & Frankie Grande gave him the idea for time travel, that led to this season's twist format.

Mickey Lee Tribute[]

The opening shot of the season was a tribute card to Big Brother 27 (US) houseguest Mickey Lee who had passed away after a series of cardiac arrests following complications from the flu.[22][23]

1000th Episode[]

For the 1000th episode, CBS sent out invitations out to previous houseguests to come to the live show. However, like with the Season 20 premiere, CBS would not pay for flights to Los Angeles, so houseguests who wished to attend must fly out themselves.

Twists[]

  • BB Block Buster: Returning for a third season in a row, the BB Block Buster forces the Head of Household to nominate three houseguests for eviction. Then on eviction night, the three nominated houseguests will have a last chance opportunity to save themselves.[28]
  • Premiere Night Safety: On premiere night, the fourteen new houseguests would not be eligible for the first Head of Household. As a result, the houseguests would compete for safety from the first eviction. After a qualifying competition, twelve of the fourteen would be divided into three groups of four in which one would win immunity for the week. The winner of each competition would unleash a "Reality Icon" into the game.
  • Additional Houseguests: After each competition on premiere night, a "Reality Icon" would then enter the game after receiving a letter telling them to show up to the Big Brother House in 2026. The icons were revealed as former Big Brother houseguest Angela Murray from Big Brother 26 (US), alongside Survivor alumni Rick Devens and Dee Valladares.[18][20][21]
    • Fake Houseguest: In was initially teased that former winner Rachel Reilly would enter the game as the seventeenth houseguest for the second consecutive season, however, it would be revealed that she was not actually playing and another icon would be taking her spot in the game. This icon was then revealed to be Dee.
  • BB Time Capsule: During the first week, a fan vote opened up giving America the option to send a houseguest into the BB Time Capsule, giving them the chance to win a power or suffer a punishment from a prior season. Beginning in Week 2 and going until Week 7, the houseguest who wins the vote will enter the Time Capsule and compete to try and earn a power, or fail and receive a punishment. There will be six different powers and punishments up for grabs. Once a houseguest is voted into the Time Capsule, they are ineligible to go in again, win or lose.
  • Year 1000 Double Eviction: To celebrate 1,000 episodes, the houseguests faced a new twist during the start of Week 8, with no HoH, PoV, or Block Buster, but still ending with someone getting sent home before the next live show, leaving the Final 9 houseguests to make up the jury phase.
    • Stone of Safety: The houseguests will be facing off in four competitions. The winner of each competition will become safe for the night and can select one other person to save alongside them. The winner and the person they save are ineligible to compete in the rest of the competitions.
    • Stone of Sacrifice: The first houseguest who wins safety must sacrifice two houseguests, forcing them to face off in the next round of competitions. The winner then earns safety for themselves and one other person, and also chooses the next person (or people) to go against the person that was left behind. The winner of the fourth and final competition will then have the sole vote to evict between the remaining houseguests who are not safe.
  • Pharaoh's Curse: The Final 5 houseguests were given the chance to have everyone get $1,000, but they would be each tempted with their own button. The first person to push that button, if anyone, would earn $10,000 for themselves, leaving everyone else with nothing. If no one pushes the button, everyone keeps their $1,000. However, unbeknownst to the houseguests, pushing the button would subsequently unleash a curse on the house, an extra "Egyptian Eviction" to determine 5th place in the middle of the week. During the eviction, the houseguests would publicly cast their votes by pressing another button, to signify who they want to evict.

Winner: Angela Murray
Result: Punishment 3 - Hard-Boiled Detective
Description: Angela must wear the "Hard-Boiled Detective" costume for a week, a costume originally featured in Big Brother 27 (US).

Winner: Rick Devens
Result: Power 5 - Diamond Power of Veto
Description: Devens earned the Diamond Power of Veto, originating from Big Brother 4 (US). With this power, he earned both the power to veto one of the nominees and to name their replacement. He was allowed to use the Diamond Power of Veto up to six weeks after obtaining the power.
Power Result: In Week 6, Devens chose to use the Diamond Power of Veto to save Dee Valladares and nominated Kamu Kirk in her place.

Winner: Dee Valladares
Result: Power 4 - BB Bribe
Description: Dee earned the BB Bribe, originating from Big Brother 18 (US). With this power, Dee is allowed to bribe any houseguest $5,000 to make any game move that she wants. It can range from nominating or not nominating specific people, to use or not use the Power of Veto, casting an eviction vote, or throwing a competition. If the houseguest takes the bribe, they must do what Dee asks of them. It can be used once for the entire season.[29]
Power Result: In Week 7, Dee successfully bribed Yash Patel to keep herself, Rick Devens, and Angela Murray safe during his next Head of Household reign, unless he had no other choice but to nominate one of them.

Winner: Mallory Aurichio
Result: Punishment 5 - Adam & Eve
Description: Mallory must be shackled by the wrist to another houseguest of her choosing for 48 hours using a “vine,” with both houseguests required to wear leaf-covered costumes as part of the “Adam and Eve” punishment, originally featured in Big Brother 16 (US). Mallory chose to be shackled to Melody Morris.

Winner: Melody Morris
Result: Punishment 1 - Lord of the Latrine
Description: Melody must become the "Lady of the Latrine" for 24 hours, a punishment originally featured in Big Brother 23 (US). Throughout that time frame, every time a houseguest needs to use the restroom, Melody must blow a horn and announce which houseguest is using the restroom to the entire house.

Winner: Drew Campbell
Result: Power 3 - Never-Not Pass
Description: Drew earned the Never-Not Pass, originating from Big Brother 15 (US). With this power, Drew was prevented from becoming a Have-Not for the rest of the season.

Power Result: Drew was spared from being a Have-Not for the rest of the season.

1 1 Immunity

"Find the BB-tonium" 		Hidden throughout the house were sticks of "BB-tonium". Twelve sticks have Enzo's correct corresponding number on the screen. The first twelve houseguests that would arrive back with the correct stick would advance to the Immunity Competitions.
Ashley & Barrett
fail to advance

"1988 Long Beach, CA" 		Each houseguest was given a mobile hanging structure and various objects with different weights. The first houseguest to balance all the objects, hit their buzzer, and have the objects hold for ten seconds would win Immunity for the week.
Rome
wins Safety

"2018 Fiji" 		Before each houseguest was a maze from one platform to the other. In order to get from one to the other, each houseguest must use two planks to solve their maze puzzle. The first houseguest to cross the maze would win Immunity for the week.
Chuk
wins Safety

"2010 Las Vegas, NV" 		In front of each houseguest was three buttons with three different phases. During each round, the houseguests must listen to the taped sequence and count which phrase was said the most. The houseguest who pressed the incorrect button or the slowest correct push would be eliminated. The last remaining houseguest would win Immunity for the week.
Jason
wins Safety
HOH
"175 Million BC" 		The three reality icons were separated by the three groups that "entered" them into the game. Each group of new houseguests would each hold a rope that would balance a platform in the middle. The reality icon would create a flame puzzle onto of that platform. The first icon to correctly solve and balance the puzzle would win HOH.

wins HOH

"Back From the Future" 		Each houseguest is given a set of pipes and various rings. Throughout the course each houseguest must create a path from one side of the course to the other passing through all the rings. The first houseguest to pass through all the rings will win the Veto.
Mallory
wins the Veto

"Do Over" 		Throughout the arena, the different screens will be flashing images of the houseguests in different wigs. The first houseguest to lock in the correct answer the quickest wins safety from the night's eviction.

is saved

Each round, the houseguests would group up in pairs to compete for the round. In each round, a different rule on how the scoring system would work to determine the winners of each round. The final houseguest survive all the rounds would win HOH.

"Pirate's Booty" 		In front of each houseguest is a set of four spools of different shaped treasures. Each treasure must be moved so each spool has three of a kind of each treasure on it. The houseguests are not allowed to set any treasures on the ground and must add it to a spool before picking up another one. The first houseguest to complete the puzzle would win safety from the night's eviction.

is saved

"The Pickle Ball" 		In a twist on the classic competition Bowlerina, each houseguest will spin on a pickle and then will use a large pickle shaped paddle to hit balls towards a wall. On the wall there are different slots with different point values. The houseguest that collects the most points in their head to head matchup wins the round, with the winner of the final round winning the Power of Veto.

wins the Veto

The object for each houseguest is to remove a videotape, without the structure falling, and return it to the start line. The houseguest to collect the most tapes in two minutes without their tower falling would win safety from the night's eviction.

is saved

After a brief study session, the houseguests would be asked a question about a certain item in each room such as a clock. In order to pass the round, the houseguests would have to hide in a room that would not have that object, or they would be eliminated. The last remaining houseguest would win HOH.

The object of the game is to select another houseguest and convince them to drink from the poisonous glass while you drink from the safe glass. "Sasquatch Watch" 		Each houseguest is up on the iconic wall hanging on to a bar on top of the wall that hangs in front of each houseguest. During random intervals, the wall would be tipped forward and back with slime shot between moving. The last houseguest to stay up on the wall would win HOH.

"Saturday Night Veto" 		In front of each houseguest is a set of tiles that light up when stepped on. When stepping on each tile, it will either turn red or green. Green means the houseguest can advance, and red would indicate an incorrect step and head back to the beginning. The set of tiles that the houseguests are stepping on are not shown to the houseguests beforehand so the houseguest must experiment to figure out which tiles are correct and which are incorrect while remembering the pattern when it resets. The first houseguest to solve their tile puzzle and make it to the end wins their match. After all the matches, the remaining houseguest would win the veto.

The first to knock their five balls off the platform would win safety from the night's eviction.

Trivia[]

  • Episode 25 (the Week 7 eviction episode) of this season was 1000th episode of the main series. To celebrate, a new twist was introduced and many alumni were honored with awards. Additionally, the series was awarded with two Guinness World Records for having the most episodes in two categories: competitive reality TV and primetime TV.
